question: Explain what this inactivity percentage means and which customers are included.

answer.text: This inactivity percentage measures customers whose last purchase fell before the inactivity cutoff out of eligible customers whose first purchase predated that same cutoff. For Calvin Klein on 2025\-10\-01, 1,264 inactive customers divided by 1,264 eligible customers gave an inactivity share of 100\.0000%. On 2026\-01\-01, 1,398 inactive customers divided by 1,399 eligible customers produced an inactivity share of 99\.9285%, shifting by \-0\.0715 percentage points.
